prompt:
REFERENCES
@image1 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — Rosa, 67: face, hair and build only.
@image3 — the entry hall: copy it — the white front door at the end, the round brass mirror over the console on the left wall, the archway on the right, the globe pendant in the middle.
@audio1 — Rosa's voice.
@audio2 — Michelle's voice.

SHOT: A warm animated family drama: Rosa bangs on the front door with wine, Michelle opens it in an old sweatshirt, and in the hall her sister holds her face up to the light; one take of 7 shots, 9:16, 25 s.

TIMELINE
[0–4s] Shot 1 · wide, follows from behind: Frame 1: Michelle at the archway in an old grey sweatshirt walking toward the front door, back to camera; Rosa unseen outside the front door, calling through it — Michelle walks four steps to the door and pulls it open. Rosa says: "Michelle, open the door. I brought wine and I am not leaving."
[4–8s] Shot 2 · medium, pushes through: the wine comes up, then lowers as her face softens; the camera pushes through past Michelle's shoulder. Rosa says: "...Oh, honey. Look at you. Come here."
[8–11s] Shot 3 · medium close-up, slow pan: Rosa's hand lifts her chin; the pan follows the tilt up.
[11–13s] Shot 4 · medium, slow creep in: her eyes slide away toward the mirror; the camera creeps in. Michelle says: "I am fine, Rosa. I am."
[13–17s] Shot 5 · medium close-up, slow tilt: her eyes slide to the mirror and her chin lowers; the camera tilts with it. Michelle says: "I just... I do not know who that woman in the mirror is anymore."
[17–22s] Shot 6 · medium, the camera arcs: she turns her head to the mirror; the camera arcs a little round her. Michelle says: "He looked at me like a stranger the day he left, and lately so do I."
[22–25s] Shot 7 · medium close-up, locked: one slow nod, the bottle set down on the console. Last frame: Michelle at the round mirror over the console, Rosa just behind her under the pendant, the wine on the console.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from the globe pendant light in the hall, a shadow side on every face. Michelle: an old oversized faded-grey sweatshirt over charcoal pull-on trousers, grey felt slippers, hair limp; Rosa: the marigold-orange wrap blouse and long ink-blue skirt, tan sandals.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — Rosa's voice from @audio1, Michelle's voice from @audio2; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: knocking on the front door, the latch and the door opening, the wine bottle set on the console; the quiet hall at night under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Michelle and Rosa in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
